title: Easy Gooey Slovakian Buckwheat Dumplings
description: A smoky and gooey Slovakian dish featuring buckwheat flour, deep-fried to perfection and suitable for kids, with a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together buckwheat flour, all purpose flour, smoked paprika, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil, about 1/4 cupfuls.
Fry the dumplings for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the dumplings from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot with crumbly feta cheese on top.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
